Order the Crispy Prawns!
May 2015 • Friends
My friends and I were taken here by a friend who is a local.

He ordered a whole roasted chicken, fried rice, pigeon, and crispy prawns. The roast chicken had nice flavor and the fried rice tasted like your standard Chinese fried rice. I wasn't a big fan of the pigeon because of all the little bones (never ate a pigeon before). My favorite thing here were the crispy prawns. Now I've had prawns at other places in Vietnam but Phi Lu serves it salt & pepper Chinese style; frying them to crispy perfection. Seriously addicting stuff!

The staff was very friendly so no problems with service. Really great spot in Da Nang for Chinese/Vietnamese cuisine.
